summary: The escaped SQLITE_BUSY occurrences on record through 2026-09-30 are Concord application defects, not storage-engine limits: the open-path key write is repaired by PR #1462, and write transactions spanning subprocesses are repaired under CON-752. No write transaction stays open across a subprocess, network call, or large filesystem operation, and the acceptance workload gains worktree claim and reclaim concurrency. CD-0011's escaped-busy reopen condition stands unchanged for later escapes, with the single-writer comparison first. Refines CD-0011.
title: The escaped SQLITE_BUSY on record is an application defect, not a storage limit
